basic_info.description: Welcome to 20 Natick Street! This free-standing rear cottage is one of two condominium homes separated by a common courtyard and entryway.  Updated kitchen, new spa-like bathroom and 2BRs upstairs with a second living area, office, full updated bathroom and third bedroom option downstairs. Period details, abundant light and two private outdoor spaces make this the place to which you will love to come home. Storage & laundry room, plus one car parking on the pad in front are included. Close to all of Glen Park's restaurants, shops, coffee emporiums, specialty grocery store, public library, playgrounds, Glen Park Canyon, BART, MUNI and tech shuttles. Very special!
